WITH s AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         CAST(qty AS REAL) AS qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS rn
  FROM monthly_sales
),
c AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         qty,
         rn,
         (AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING)
        + AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING)) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM s
),
r AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         qty / cma AS ratio
  FROM c
  WHERE rn BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND cma > 0
    AND strftime('%Y', mth) = '2017'
)
SELECT product_id
FROM r
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 AND MIN(ratio) > 2
ORDER BY product_id

WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment_total FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id), cust AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders, AVG(ot.order_payment_total) AS avg_payment_per_order, CAST(JULIANDAY(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS REAL) AS lifespan_days FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT customer_unique_id, num_orders, avg_payment_per_order, CASE WHEN lifespan_days < 7 THEN 1.0 ELSE lifespan_days / 7.0 END AS lifespan_weeks FROM cust ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC LIMIT 3

WITH career AS (
  SELECT b.player_id,
         SUM(CAST(b.g AS INTEGER)) AS g,
         SUM(CAST(b.r AS INTEGER)) AS r,
         SUM(CAST(b.h AS INTEGER)) AS h,
         SUM(CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER)) AS hr
  FROM batting AS b
  GROUP BY b.player_id
),
tops AS (
  SELECT 1 AS ord, 'games played' AS stat, p.name_given AS name_given, c.g AS score_value
  FROM career AS c
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
  WHERE c.g IS NOT NULL AND c.g = (SELECT MAX(g) FROM career)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'runs', p.name_given, c.r
  FROM career AS c
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
  WHERE c.r IS NOT NULL AND c.r = (SELECT MAX(r) FROM career)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'hits', p.name_given, c.h
  FROM career AS c
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
  WHERE c.h IS NOT NULL AND c.h = (SELECT MAX(h) FROM career)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'home runs', p.name_given, c.hr
  FROM career AS c
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
  WHERE c.hr IS NOT NULL AND c.hr = (SELECT MAX(hr) FROM career)
)
SELECT name_given, score_value, stat
FROM tops
ORDER BY ord, score_value DESC

WITH party_helmet AS (
  SELECT case_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used'
                    OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helmet_used,
         MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet not used'
                    OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet not used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helmet_not_used
  FROM parties
  GROUP BY case_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ph.helmet_used = 1 THEN COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ph.helmet_used = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ph.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ph.helmet_not_used = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM collisions c
JOIN party_helmet ph ON ph.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1

SELECT w.name AS winner_name, l.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON CAST(m.title_id AS INTEGER) = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w ON CAST(m.winner_id AS INTEGER) = w.id
JOIN Wrestlers l ON CAST(m.loser_id AS INTEGER) = l.id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
  AND m.duration <> ''
ORDER BY m.duration ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH d AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, oi.seller_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
r AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, rv.review_id
  FROM olist_order_reviews rv
  JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = rv.order_id
  JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = rv.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND rv.review_score = 5
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement, seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS metric_value FROM d GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC, seller_id LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest profit (price - freight)', seller_id, ROUND(SUM(price - freight_value), 2) FROM d GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC, seller_id LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct orders', seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM d GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC, seller_id LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the most 5-star ratings', seller_id, COUNT(review_id) FROM r GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC, seller_id LIMIT 1)

SELECT c.name AS category, SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
JOIN city ct ON ct.city_id = a.city_id
WHERE (ct.city LIKE 'A%' OR ct.city LIKE '%-%') AND r.return_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
  GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_a AS (SELECT ArtistId FROM sales ORDER BY total DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 1),
low_a AS (SELECT ArtistId FROM sales ORDER BY total ASC, Name ASC LIMIT 1),
ct AS (
  SELECT i.CustomerId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS amt
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN invoices i ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  WHERE al.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_a)
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId
),
cl AS (
  SELECT i.CustomerId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS amt
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN invoices i ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  WHERE al.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_a)
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId
)
SELECT ABS((SELECT AVG(amt) FROM ct) - (SELECT AVG(amt) FROM cl)) AS difference

WITH monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
month_stats AS (
  SELECT month_num,
         SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customers,
         AVG(CAST(month_end_balance AS REAL)) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balance
  GROUP BY month_num
),
hi AS (
  SELECT month_num, positive_customers, avg_balance
  FROM month_stats
  ORDER BY positive_customers DESC, month_num ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
lo AS (
  SELECT month_num, positive_customers, avg_balance
  FROM month_stats
  ORDER BY positive_customers ASC, month_num DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT hi.month_num AS highest_positive_month,
       hi.positive_customers AS highest_month_positive_customers,
       hi.avg_balance AS highest_month_avg_balance,
       lo.month_num AS lowest_positive_month,
       lo.positive_customers AS lowest_month_positive_customers,
       lo.avg_balance AS lowest_month_avg_balance,
       hi.avg_balance - lo.avg_balance AS avg_balance_difference
FROM hi, lo

WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT o.customerid AS customerid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.orderid = o.orderid WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderdate) = '1998' GROUP BY o.customerid), grouped AS (SELECT t.groupname AS groupname, cs.customerid AS customerid FROM customer_spending cs JOIN customergroupthreshold t ON cs.total_spent >= t.rangebottom AND cs.total_spent <= t.rangetop) SELECT g.groupname, COUNT(g.customerid) AS num_customers, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(g.customerid) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_spending), 2) AS pct_customers FROM grouped g GROUP BY g.groupname ORDER BY num_customers DESC

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT r.id AS region_id,
         r.name AS region_name,
         sr.id AS rep_id,
         sr.name AS rep_name,
         COUNT(o.id) AS rep_orders,
         SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
  JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region_id,
         SUM(rep_orders) AS region_orders,
         SUM(rep_sales) AS region_sales
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
),
best_rep AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(rep_sales) AS max_sales
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT rs.region_name,
       rt.region_orders AS num_orders,
       rt.region_sales AS total_sales_amount,
       rs.rep_name AS top_sales_rep_name,
       rs.rep_sales AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM rep_sales rs
JOIN best_rep b ON b.region_id = rs.region_id AND rs.rep_sales = b.max_sales
JOIN region_totals rt ON rt.region_id = rs.region_id
ORDER BY rt.region_sales DESC, rs.rep_name

WITH sales AS (SELECT salespersonid AS businessentityid, strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS salesyear, SUM(totaldue) AS totalsales FROM salesorderheader WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salespersonid, strftime('%Y', orderdate)), quota AS (SELECT BusinessEntityID AS businessentityid, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS salesyear, SUM(SalesQuota) AS totalquota FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)), keys AS (SELECT businessentityid, salesyear FROM sales UNION SELECT businessentityid, salesyear FROM quota) SELECT k.businessentityid AS salespersonid, k.salesyear AS year, ROUND(COALESCE(s.totalsales, 0), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(COALESCE(q.totalquota, 0), 2) AS total_quota, ROUND(COALESCE(s.totalsales, 0) - COALESCE(q.totalquota, 0), 2) AS sales_minus_quota FROM keys k LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.businessentityid = k.businessentityid AND s.salesyear = k.salesyear LEFT JOIN quota q ON q.businessentityid = k.businessentityid AND q.salesyear = k.salesyear ORDER BY k.businessentityid, k.salesyear

WITH dm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name_id, movie_id
  FROM director_mapping
),
dir_movies AS (
  SELECT dm.name_id AS director_id,
         m.id AS movie_id,
         m.date_published,
         m.duration,
         r.avg_rating,
         r.total_votes
  FROM dm
  INNER JOIN movies m ON m.id = dm.movie_id
  LEFT JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         julianday(date_published) - julianday(LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY date_published, movie_id)) AS gap_days
  FROM dir_movies
  WHERE date_published IS NOT NULL
),
gap_avg AS (
  SELECT director_id, AVG(gap_days) AS avg_gap_days
  FROM gaps
  WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY director_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) AS num_movies,
         ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         SUM(total_votes) AS total_votes,
         MIN(avg_rating) AS min_rating,
         MAX(avg_rating) AS max_rating,
         SUM(duration) AS total_duration
  FROM dir_movies
  GROUP BY director_id
)
SELECT a.director_id AS director_id,
       n.name AS director_name,
       a.num_movies AS num_movies,
       CAST(ROUND(g.avg_gap_days) AS INTEGER) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
       a.avg_rating AS avg_rating,
       a.total_votes AS total_votes,
       a.min_rating AS min_rating,
       a.max_rating AS max_rating,
       a.total_duration AS total_duration
FROM agg a
INNER JOIN names n ON n.id = a.director_id
LEFT JOIN gap_avg g ON g.director_id = a.director_id
ORDER BY a.num_movies DESC, a.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH RECURSIVE cohort AS (SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING MIN(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'), periods(year_offset) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT year_offset + 1 FROM periods WHERE year_offset < 19), flags AS (SELECT p.year_offset AS year_offset, c.id_bioguide AS id_bioguide, MAX(CASE WHEN t.term_start <= (CAST(strftime('%Y', c.first_start) AS INTEGER) + p.year_offset) || '-12-31' AND t.term_end >= (CAST(strftime('%Y', c.first_start) AS INTEGER) + p.year_offset) || '-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS still_in_office FROM periods p CROSS JOIN cohort c LEFT JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide GROUP BY p.year_offset, c.id_bioguide) SELECT year_offset, SUM(still_in_office) AS retained_legislators, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, CAST(SUM(still_in_office) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate FROM flags GROUP BY year_offset ORDER BY year_offset

WITH film_rev AS (
  SELECT i.film_id AS film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_cnt AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS n_actors FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT fa.actor_id AS actor_id,
         fr.film_id AS film_id,
         f.title AS title,
         fr.revenue AS film_revenue,
         fr.revenue / ac.n_actors AS revenue_per_actor,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.actor_id ORDER BY fr.revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN film_rev fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fr.film_id
  JOIN actor_cnt ac ON ac.film_id = fr.film_id
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY actor_id, film_revenue DESC
)
SELECT a.actor_id AS actor_id,
       a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name,
       GROUP_CONCAT(t.title, ', ') AS top_three_films,
       ROUND(AVG(t.revenue_per_actor), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 t
JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = t.actor_id
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_actor DESC

WITH RECURSIVE wl(word) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words FROM word_list WHERE length(words) IN (4,5)
),
sp(word, i, ch) AS (
  SELECT word, 1, substr(word,1,1) FROM wl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT word, i+1, substr(word,i+1,1) FROM sp WHERE i < length(word)
),
ky AS (
  SELECT word,
         group_concat(ch,'') OVER (PARTITION BY word ORDER BY ch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS k
  FROM sp
),
kd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT word, k FROM ky
),
grp AS (
  SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM kd GROUP BY k
)
SELECT kd.word AS word, grp.n - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM kd
JOIN grp ON grp.k = kd.k
WHERE substr(kd.word,1,1) = 'r' AND grp.n >= 2
ORDER BY kd.word
LIMIT 10

SELECT h.hub_id,
       h.hub_name,
       t.feb_orders,
       t.mar_orders,
       ROUND((CAST(t.mar_orders AS REAL) - t.feb_orders) / t.feb_orders * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM (SELECT s.hub_id,
             SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_orders,
             SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_orders
      FROM orders o
      JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
      WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
        AND o.order_created_year = 2021
        AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
      GROUP BY s.hub_id) t
JOIN hubs h ON h.hub_id = t.hub_id
WHERE t.feb_orders > 0
  AND (CAST(t.mar_orders AS REAL) - t.feb_orders) / t.feb_orders > 0.20
ORDER BY growth_pct DESC

WITH results AS (SELECT m.season AS season, m.league_id AS league_id, m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pts FROM Match m WHERE m.home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.away_team_api_id, CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3 WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM Match m WHERE m.away_team_api_id IS NOT NULL), standings AS (SELECT season, league_id, team_api_id, SUM(pts) AS total_points FROM results GROUP BY season, league_id, team_api_id), ranked AS (SELECT s.season, s.league_id, s.team_api_id, s.total_points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.season, s.league_id ORDER BY s.total_points DESC, t.team_long_name ASC) AS rn FROM standings s JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = s.team_api_id) SELECT r.season AS season, t.team_long_name AS champion_team, l.name AS league, c.name AS country, r.total_points AS total_points FROM ranked r JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id JOIN League l ON l.id = r.league_id JOIN Country c ON c.id = l.country_id WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.season, c.name, l.name

WITH item_base AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.order_id, oi.price,
         julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS packing_days
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
),
seller_stats AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(*) AS quantity_sold,
         SUM(price) AS total_sales,
         AVG(price) AS avg_item_price,
         AVG(packing_days) AS avg_packing_days
  FROM item_base
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
  SELECT ib.seller_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM item_base ib
  JOIN order_reviews r ON ib.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY ib.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_name_english,
         SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rn
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
)
SELECT ss.seller_id,
       ss.quantity_sold,
       ROUND(ss.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(ss.avg_item_price, 2) AS avg_item_price,
       ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) AS avg_review_score,
       ROUND(ss.avg_packing_days, 2) AS avg_packing_days,
       cs.product_category_name_english AS top_selling_category_english
FROM seller_stats ss
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sr.seller_id = ss.seller_id
LEFT JOIN category_sales cs ON cs.seller_id = ss.seller_id AND cs.rn = 1
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT session,
         path,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) AS rn_first,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM activity_log
)
SELECT path,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS total_unique_sessions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_first = 1 OR rn_last = 1
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY total_unique_sessions DESC, path

SELECT DISTINCT T3.forename, T3.surname
FROM drives AS T1
INNER JOIN drives AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.driver_id = T2.driver_id
INNER JOIN constructors AS C1 ON C1.constructor_id = T1.constructor_id
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driver_id = T1.driver_id
WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND T1.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND T2.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
  AND T1.constructor_id = T2.constructor_id
  AND T2.last_round - T1.first_round >= 1
ORDER BY T3.surname, T3.forename
